verdict.line: You lose if you let Tahm stack three Tongue Lashes for a free stun into Devour before level 6; you win if you deny his Q angles with minions and press the Fear Beyond Death execute window once six hits.

brief.thesis: Tahm Kench's Tongue Lash actually out-ranges Urgot's Corrosive Charge (900 vs 800), so this isn't a simple kite lane — it's won or lost on whether Urgot blocks that skillshot with minions and brush. Urgot vs Tahm Kench sits at 53.8% over 106 games against a 51.4% baseline, so the matchup leans Urgot once you respect the stack-and-stun pattern instead of trying to out-range him in the open.

theirWindow.when: he holds 2 Acquired Taste stacks on you
theirWindow.what: Disengage for a rotation. A third Tongue Lash stuns you and consumes the stacks, opening a free combo or a Devour setup — don't stand in his sightline until the stacks fall off or he's forced to waste the Q elsewhere.

yourWindow.when: his Tongue Lash and Abyssal Dive are both down
yourWindow.what: Step up and unload Q (Corrosive Charge) into W (Purge) — Purge prioritizes champions you've already hit and triggers Echoing Flames, so chaining Q into W during his 5-7s Q cooldown and 17-21s W cooldown is your highest-damage window with no stun or dive threat back.

start.why: Backed by 54.9% over 122 games — the extra sustain and auto damage let you win the poke trades that spill over from blocked Tongue Lashes without losing the HP race.

boots.why: 41.6% pick at 50.9% WR — Tahm's Q, W, and Devour are all magic damage, so the MR and tenacity blunt both his poke and any stun-into-all-in attempt.

core.why: 66.7% WR over 24 games as the first core item — armor shred stacks fast off repeated Purge ticks and turns extended trades in your favor.
The bonus health and tenacity directly counter a stun-into-Devour combo, keeping you alive through his one big window.
Completes the 66.7%-WR path — stacking resistances lets you out-sustain his Acquired Taste health-scaling damage in extended fights.

situational.when: he's building into your right-click damage and leaning on Thick Skin to out-sustain you
his Devour and Abyssal Dive burst is threatening to one-shot you off a single all-in
you need to close the gap on a Tahm who's kiting with Q poke and refusing to trade

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in the 60%-pick page at 23.7% — your autos and Q land often enough in close-range Purge trades to stack and detonate PTA before he can disengage.

summoners.why: 81.1% pick at 55% WR — Ignite's grievous wounds cuts both his Q sustain and Thick Skin's passive heal, and Flash backs up your all-in the moment Fear Beyond Death comes online at 6.

playing.title: Block Tongue Lash with minions
playing.detail: Tahm's Q is a skillshot that damages and slows only the first unit hit — stand behind your casters or inside brush so he has to walk up for a clean angle, burning his 7-5s cooldown for nothing.

playing.title: Never sit at 2 stacks
playing.detail: A third Tongue Lash on an already-stacked target stuns and consumes the stacks for free follow-up damage. Reset your position the moment you're at two instead of risking the third hit.

playing.title: All-in the instant 6 hits
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death fires a chem-drill that impales and can execute a champion below the health threshold — look for any moment he's pushed up to use Disdain (E), which stops on the first champion hit and hurls him out of position, then follow with R.

playing.title: Bait Thick Skin before committing
playing.detail: His E converts stored damage into a shield on activation. Poke once outside his melee range first so he either burns the shield early or eats chip damage, then commit your all-in into the gap.

playing.title: Track Abyssal Dive's cooldown
playing.detail: At 21/20/19/18/17s, his W is his only gap-close and disengage. The moment he uses it to engage or reposition, shove the wave — he has no dive back for up to 21 seconds.

playing.title: Don't channel Purge into a healthy Tahm at 6+
playing.detail: His Devour has no cooldown and deals magic damage over its duration with no counterplay once it lands. Against a full-HP Tahm post-6, disengage rather than trading extended W channels at point-blank range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample-size numbers above are measured from current-patch OP.GG games on this matchup; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance from Tahm Kench during early game. Use brushes to contest lane and wait for a chance after reaching level 6.
